title: Comparison shopper gets a rate quoted to keep her on the line
scenario: Renee is comparing three lenders for a purchase and says she's just collecting numbers. The rep panics and quotes a specific rate to keep her interested.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Hi Renee, Derek with Copperleaf Home Loans. Thanks for picking up.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Hi. Yeah, so, full disclosure, I'm talking to like three lenders. I'm just comparing right now.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Smart, you should compare. What are you buying, if you don't mind me asking?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: A townhouse, it's a new build. They say it'll be done in the spring.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Oh nice, new construction. Are you working with the builder's lender too?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: They pushed theirs, yeah. That's one of the three.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Okay. And what's most important to you in picking one, rate, fees, service?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Honestly, rate. That's all anyone talks about. So what's your rate today?

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: For a townhouse purchase like that, I can get you six and an eighth today, easy.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Huh. The builder's guy said something a little higher than that.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Yeah, we're usually pretty sharp.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Does that include points or whatever?

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Well, it depends on the full scenario, credit and down payment and all that.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Okay, so it's not really six and an eighth then.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: It could be. I'd need to run your full picture to say for sure.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Right. Okay. I've got a meeting in a few, so I'm going to have to go.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Totally. Can I send you a quick application link?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Sure, send it over, I'll look at it.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Will do. Thanks Renee.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Bye.
